title: Task 3: Extract and integrate five gamemastering rules
description:
Objective:
Extract the five approved prose rules, wire both gamemastering slices into runImporter, and enforce exact canonical rule/table coverage.

Files:
- Create: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseGamemasteringRules.ts
- Create: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseGamemasteringRules.test.ts
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/index.ts
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/cli.ts
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts
- Modify: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/pipeline.test.ts

Steps:
1. RED: Add unit fixtures asserting exactly five RuleExtraction values and stable key slugs: madness, going-mad, madness-effects, curing-madness, objects. Assert Madness keeps only its introduction; Going Mad/Madness Effects/Curing Madness stop at their next heading/table boundary; Objects includes Statistics for Objects, Armor Class/Hit Points guidance, Huge and Gargantuan Objects, Objects and Damage Types, and Damage Threshold prose while excluding both object table headers/rows.
2. RED: Extend the pipeline fixture with Madness -> Objects -> Poisons pages and assert five new rule keys and five new table keys. Add missing-end tests for Madness and Objects boundaries. Run focused parser/pipeline tests and observe expected failures.
3. GREEN: Implement parseGamemasteringRules(madnessPages, objectPages) using line heights and fixed reviewed captions, returning exactly five keySlug-bearing rules. Slice both sections with the new anchors, parse them, reserve/merge them with existing rules, and feed both slices to parseTables.
4. Add EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_TABLE_NAMES and TableCoverageError plus expectedTableNames on RunImporterInput. Extend EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_RULE_KEYS with the five rule keys. Pass expected rule/table baselines from both importer CLI and verify CLI, and validate before writing output.
5. Re-run focused unit/pipeline tests; expect PASS. Run npm run typecheck.
6. REFACTOR: Keep the parser focused on these two sections and error messages deterministic; do not change generic parseRules.
design: parseGamemasteringRules owns the section-root behavior generic parseRules does not model. Madness root text is the pre-Going-Mad introduction; tiered child bodies are bounded by the next heading. Object text is consolidated into one record after filtering exact table caption/header/row shapes, preserving all prose subheadings and paragraphs. Missing starts may remain empty only for reduced fixtures; requireEndHeading errors propagate, and the real CLI/verify exact baselines make canonical missing starts fail closed.
acceptance_criteria:
- Exactly five approved rule records emit with stable keys and source-faithful bodies.
- Rules contain no table rows and no Diseases/Poisons bleed.
- Pipeline emits the five new tables and five rules.
- Missing Madness->Objects or Objects->Poisons end boundaries throw SectionNotFoundError.
- Real CLI and verify CLI pass exact full rule-key and table-name baselines to runImporter.
- Focused tests and typecheck pass.
close_reason: Integrated five gamemastering rules and five tables with exact rule/table coverage gates in importer and verifier; focused tests, typecheck, and real CLI pass.
